name: Описание музыкального произведения
description: Структурированный бриф для музыкальной генерации/композитора: жанр, настрой, темп, форма, инструментовка

slots.label: Жанр
slots.description: Например: ambient, jazz fusion, orchestral, techno

slots.label: Инструменты
slots.description: Через запятую: piano, strings, synth pads, double bass

rules.append: Loop note: build intensity layer by layer; every 8 bars add or remove exactly one element.
Ambient note: no percussion, slowly evolving textures, long reverb tails, subtle harmonic shifts.
Choir note: wordless vocalise, layered harmonies, cathedral-like space.

examples:
Compose an original piece of music and describe it precisely.
Genre: jazz fusion
Mood: тревожное
Tempo: 132 BPM, restless
Instrumentation: Rhodes piano, upright bass, brushed drums, tenor sax
Form: through-composed
Vocals: instrumental

Description of the desired result:
A coherent jazz fusion piece with a clear тревожное emotional character. Introduce the main theme early, develop it through a contrasting middle section, then return to the theme with a resolved ending. Keep the arrangement balanced: leave space for each instrument, shape dynamics from quiet intro to the loudest point of the climax.

Return: a structured description of sections with timings, followed by production notes (mix, space, texture).
